L9.name: Run!
trap.auto-run: On the yellow floor you cannot stop running – jump the pit, the block and the wide pit right at their edges.
trap.backward-camera: The camera looks behind you, so things ahead pop up late – a spike, a pit, a block with a spike after it, then a wide pit.
trap.biting-coin: The coin lying in the trough has teeth – jump over the whole trough.
trap.blackout: The lights go out and you only see around you – walk slowly: a pit, two spikes, a wide pit, a block and a last pit.
trap.blinking-platform: The two platforms blink out every few seconds – start hopping right after they come back.
trap.broken-jump: Jump does not work on the 2 grey tiles before the pit – take off just before the grey tiles.
trap.camera-freeze: The camera stops following you – keep going and watch the yellow arrow: jump three pits, 7, 14 and 19 tiles after the start of the frozen stretch.
trap.catapult-spring: Stepping on the stone plate makes the spring lob a spiked ball at you – keep running under it.
trap.chasing-wall: A spike wall chases you, only a little slower than you – never stop: hop the bump, jump the pit, jump the block.
trap.coin-arc: The coins above the pit bite – cross it with a small hop that stays under them.
trap.coin-bomb: The coin in the tunnel explodes into spikes a moment after you grab it – keep running.
trap.coin-rain: Coins rain down in three columns – wait until a shower hits the ground, then dash through.
trap.coin-trail: The coin trail from the high walkway leads into the pit – stay low and jump the pit from the ground.
trap.coin-wall: The lower half of the coin wall bites – jump so you fly through its top half.
trap.collapsing-floor: The cracked floor in the dip crumbles shortly after you step on it – keep walking across.
trap.controls-swap: On the purple floor left and right are swapped – hold LEFT to go right, and LEFT+jump over its pit.
trap.conveyor-floor: After the little pit the floor is a conveyor belt that drags you back into it – keep running right.
trap.copycat-frog: The spiked frog jumps whenever you jump – do a small hop when it is about 4 tiles away and run under it while it is in the air.
trap.crumbling-bridge: The long bridge crumbles plank by plank right after you step on it – keep running across.
trap.crusher-slab: The cracked slab crashes down a moment after you step under it – sprint through without stopping.
trap.cursed-coin: Do not jump for the lone coin above the stage – walk underneath it.
trap.decoy-hero: A fake you runs back and the camera follows it – follow the yellow arrow: the real you jumps a pit, a wide pit, a block and a wide pit.
trap.descending-ceiling: The spiked ceiling lowers as soon as you enter – hurry to the pit and jump it while there is still room.
trap.domino-stalactites: Once you pass the first stalactite they all fall one after another behind you – keep running.
trap.door-tongue: The door shoots out a spiked tongue when you come near – stop, let it lick and pull back, then jump over the door.
trap.dropping-ceiling-spikes: The spikes under the low rock drop when you come near – step back, let them fall and rise, then go.
trap.dud-spring: The first (rusty) spring over the void is a dud – jump past it onto the red one.
trap.elevator-spikes: The elevator goes all the way up into the spikes – jump right onto the ledge on the way up.
trap.escalating-spring: The spring in the well bounces you higher each time – jump off to the right on the second bounce.
trap.exit-swap: The EXIT ahead swaps itself for a biting fake when you come near – jump over the fake one.
trap.fake-ceiling: The open hole in the low ceiling hides spikes – the way up is the cracked part that looks solid.
trap.fake-exit: That EXIT under the steps is fake and bites – climb the steps and go over the wall.
trap.fake-floor: Two tiles in the middle of the plateau are fake – jump over them.
trap.fake-victory: The "level clear" card is fake – do not stop under it: a spiked ball drops right there. Keep running and jump the pit.
trap.ferris-wheel: Step onto a wheel platform as it comes up past the left island, ride it over the top and step off onto the right island before it dips into the spikes.
trap.flip-on-jump: On the blue strip jump flips gravity – flip up before the pit, then flip down right after it, before the ceiling spikes.
trap.flip-platform: The platform turns over every few seconds and its spikes come up top – cross right after it turns back.
trap.floating-bubble: Inside the bubble over the pit you float upward – do not jump or stop, walk straight through it.
trap.floor-eater: Something eats the thin bridge behind you faster than you can run – get up on the stone pillars and hop from pillar to pillar.
trap.frozen-controls: The pale strip freezes your controls for a second and you keep sliding – step onto it slowly.
trap.giant-coin: The coin in the low corridor puffs up into a giant spiked coin – stop, wait until it shrinks, then go.
trap.gravity-flip: Gravity suddenly flips and you fall up – let go of the keys so you land before the ceiling spikes, then jump over them.
trap.gravity-flip-back: At the end of the ceiling walk gravity flips back above spikes – keep holding RIGHT while you fall.
trap.gravity-pulse: Gravity flips up and down every moment – keep running: cross the floor spikes while you are on the ceiling.
trap.ground-falls-up: A chunk of the ground ahead falls up into the sky when you come near – jump over the hole it leaves.
trap.hard-landing-hatch: The bolted hatch after the spike breaks if you land on it hard – clear the spike with a tiny tap jump.
trap.heavy-gravity: On the dark floor you are so heavy you fall into the thin cracks – hop over each crack.
trap.hiccup-jump: On the green floor you hop by yourself every moment – wait in each gap for a hop, then run under the next spikes.
trap.hidden-exit: The wall top is spiked – step down from the stairs and walk into the wall: the real EXIT hides inside it.
trap.hidden-spring: A spring pops out of the floor under the spiked bar – jump over that spot.
trap.homing-bird: A spiked bird hunts you, faster than you can run – hide in the low tunnel ahead: it crashes into the roof.
trap.ice-floor: The blue floor is ice: you cannot stop on it – keep running and jump at its very end.
trap.input-lag: On the teal floor every button reacts late – press jump about two tiles before the pit.
trap.invisible-floor: An invisible bridge crosses the wide pit, but it starts 2 tiles out – jump from the edge, then walk.
trap.kick-door: The door after the pit kicks you back into it – jump over the door.
trap.loose-brick: Do not jump into the bolted brick – bonking it drops spiked rocks on you. Just walk under it.
trap.low-gravity: Gravity is weak at the end of the top step – do not jump (you would hit the spikes); just walk off the edge and float across.
trap.loyal-platform: The platform follows you across the pit, but slowly – walk in short steps and stay above it.
trap.overshoot-spring: The diagonal spring throws you way too far – let go of the keys after it launches you to land on the small island.
trap.portal-door: The door in the wall is a portal and you come out just as fast, right before a pit – walk in slowly.
trap.pulley-platforms: The two platforms hang on a pulley: yours sinks while the other rises – jump across as soon as it is a bit higher, then straight on to the high island.
trap.rising-flood: A floor of spikes rises out of the pit – climb the ledges quickly without waiting.
trap.rolling-ball: A spiked ball rolls after you, faster than you – keep running and jump the ditch: the ball falls into it.
trap.rubber-floor: The springy floor only bounces when you land on it hard – walk on it and jump only under the gap in the ceiling.
trap.runaway-exit: The EXIT on the ledge runs away – do not walk off after it: jump from the very edge of the ledge.
trap.safe-notch: The whole roof slab crashes down – drop into the slot in the floor and wait there until it lifts.
trap.screen-flip: The screen turns upside down – your keys still work normally: jump the pit, walk under the spiked bar without jumping, jump the wide pit.
trap.screen-smudge: A smudge on the screen hides what is ahead – jump onto the block, then over the gap to the next block, then over a pit.
trap.seasick-tilt: The screen rocks like a ship and the steps look tilted – they are level: jump up two steps, down one, then across.
trap.shadow-clone: A shadow of you follows your exact path a moment later – touching it kills: never stop and never go back.
trap.shuttle-dive: The moving platform dives halfway across – jump to the far island before it does.
trap.shy-platform: The platform slides two tiles away when you jump at it – aim two tiles further than it is.
trap.sideways-spring: The blue spring flings you sideways into spikes – jump over it.
trap.sinking-floor: The cracked floor ahead slowly sinks into the abyss – step on it and jump off to the right straight away.
trap.slamming-doors: The three doors snap open and shut in turn – go through each one right after it opens.
trap.spike-turret: The turret at the end fires spiked balls along the floor – jump over each ball as it comes, then hop onto the turret.
trap.spiked-fish: A spiked fish leaps out of the pit as you come near – wait at the edge until it drops back, then jump.
trap.splitting-platform: The left half of the platform drops away when you land on it – jump from the very edge to land on its right half.
trap.spring-ceiling: The spring shoots you at spikes – hold LEFT while flying to go up through the gap.
trap.storm-cloud: A storm cloud follows you and strikes where you stand – only stop under the stone roofs, and pass the spikes when they are down.
trap.strobe-lights: It is dark except for short flashes – a pit, a block, a wide pit, a spike before a spiked bar (hop it low), then a pit.
trap.super-jump: On the orange floor every jump is super strong – cross the pit with a short tap so you stay under the spiked roof.
trap.teleporting-platform: The platform blinks out and reappears 4 tiles further – stand on it and jump forward the moment it blinks, then again.
trap.thwomp: The stone block slams down in a steady rhythm – wait until it lifts, then run under it.
trap.tunnel-vision: The camera zooms right in – go slowly: a pit, a spiked block (jump over it), another pit and a single spike follow.
trap.turbo-speed: On the red floor you run twice as fast – make a tiny hop onto the island, then a full jump from its edge.
ui.controlsHelp: Arrows / WASD to move · Space to jump · Esc to pause
ui.rotateSub: Don't Trust the Door plays sideways.
ui.tagline: a troll platformer where the level betrays you
ui.title: Don't Trust the Door
